complete_examples.text: Firstly, the conventional structural detailing is shown in Fig. 1a. Secondly, after employing the anti-collapse design, the additional reinforcement layer for collapse miti-gation is placed at the top and bottom of the beam sections.
Therefore, placing the additional reinforcement layer at the midheight of the beam section is aimed to improve the influence of flexural rotation and strengthen the beam-column connection.
